# Retired one-time workflows

Archived 2026-11-24 from main. Historical definitions are not executable by GitHub Actions here. These are targeted repairs, cache busts, or special deployments, not recurring maintenance. Do not restore or run without reviewing current code. Archiving does not assert that every original patch succeeded. Reusable deployment, diagnostics, load testing and migration workflows are retained pending separate lifecycle review.
